channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: 9/11 American Heroes: Patricia Horoho
item.description: An Army nurse rushed toward the Pentagon impact site on 9/11 without supplies, treating 75 people at a triage point she established.

item.title: NASA's orbital data centers could ease Earth's energy and land disputes
item.description: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman suggests solar-powered AI data centers in orbit could address U.S. conflicts over land, water, and grid capacity.

item.title: Maine Democrat with Canadian border district supports Trump's tariffs
item.description: Rep. Jared Golden, D-Maine, whose district borders Canada, backs President Trump's escalating tariff measures.

item.title: Trump administration increases deportation flights to Haiti
item.description: The Trump administration plans to boost deportation flights to Haiti, potentially accelerating the removal of thousands of Haitians.
